note: Media markets (Nielsen DMAs) with their big-four affiliates. 'ota' is the station's virtual over-the-air channel. DirecTV and Dish carry locals on the same number as OTA in almost every market, so they default to it. Cable numbers vary by headend and are left for the user to set once. Streaming services (YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, Sling, DirecTV Stream) have no channel numbers: find the station by call sign. 'teams' lists the local team(s) in priority order for regional-game resolution; 'affinity' lists nearby teams the market usually receives when its own team is not playing.
